title: ERN2/XBP1-AGR2 mediated endoplasmic reticulum stress increased neutrophilic asthma mucus secretion.
authors: Yang, Jing; Li, Xiaofang; Ye, Bei; Luo, Zhiyan; Huang, Huiting; Peng, Xiaoyun; Wen, Wujin; Liao, Gang; Liang, Huiqiu; Jiang, Yong; Zhan, Shaofeng; Liu, Qiong; Huang, Xiufang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究哮喘中ERS相关蛋白互作与黏液分泌，虽含分子动力学模拟蛋白互作，但核心非TF-DNA结合体系，且以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟仅辅助验证。
abstract: A major pathogenic mechanism of neutrophilic asthma (NA) may be the excessive secretion of mucus, which causes variable degrees of airflow obstruction. This study showed the critical role of endoplasmic reticulum stress response (ERS) in NA mucus hypersecretion. Multiple bioinformatics methods indicated that ERN2 and AGR2 were essential genes in ERS in NA and were found to be tightly related to XBP1 and MUC5AC. Then, the NA mouse model, ERS model in HBE135-E6E7 and lentivirus-infected HEK-293 T cells were constructed to verify the bioinformatics results. Airway mucus hypersecretion and the intensity of ERS were decreased by inhibiting ERN2 in vivo (4mu8C) and in vitro (lentivirus). Furthermore, 4mu8C could dramatically reduce the concentration of protein in BALF, the levels of inflammatory cytokines in serum or BALF, and the quantity of leukocytes, particularly neutrophils, in BALF. Meanwhile, 4mu8C and lentivirus suppressed the mRNA and protein expression of ERN2, XBP1, AGR2 and MUC5AC and inhibited connections between them. The interaction between ERN2 and AGR2 was confirmed by molecular dynamics simulation and Co-IP assays in vitro. Therefore, we speculated that the primary method to lessen airway mucus hypersecretion in NA was to suppress the ERN2/XBP1-AGR2 axis to attenuate ERS, which lowered MUC5AC secretion.
abstract_zh: 中性粒细胞性哮喘（NA）的主要致病机制可能是黏液过度分泌，导致不同程度的气流阻塞。本研究揭示了内质网应激反应（ERS）在NA黏液高分泌中的关键作用。多种生物信息学方法表明，ERN2和AGR2是NA中ERS的关键基因，并与XBP1和MUC5AC密切相关。随后，构建了NA小鼠模型、HBE135-E6E7中的ERS模型以及慢病毒感染的HEK-293 T细胞，以验证生物信息学结果。通过体内（4mu8C）和体外（慢病毒）抑制ERN2，气道黏液高分泌和ERS强度均有所降低。此外，4mu8C能显著降低支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）中蛋白质浓度、血清或BALF中炎症细胞因子水平，以及BALF中白细胞（特别是中性粒细胞）的数量。同时，4mu8C和慢病毒抑制了ERN2、XBP1、AGR2和MUC5AC的mRNA和蛋白质表达，并削弱了它们之间的相互作用。分子动力学模拟和体外Co-IP实验证实了ERN2与AGR2之间的相互作用。因此，我们推测减轻NA气道黏液高分泌的主要方法是通过抑制ERN2/XBP1-AGR2轴来减弱ERS，从而降低MUC5AC分泌。
